releaseNotes:
### 14.4.12

* Upgrades System.Security.Cryptography.Pkcs to fix denial-of-service vulnerabilities CVE-2026-70162 and CVE-2026-84008. (GH#3806)
* Fixes `FetchLatestChromeHeadlessShell` leaving older Chrome versions behind and deleting folders it didn't create. (L#GDPIC-1683)
* Fixes garbled Unicode attachment filenames when reading MSG emails. (L#MAMBO-2066)
* Fixes loading the SDK on Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9, Rocky Linux 9 and AlmaLinux 9. (GH#4135)
* Fixes the COM edition GdPicture.NET.14.dll in the installer shipping without a code signature. (L#GDPIC-1597)

#### Barcode

* Fixes an intermittent crash of the process while reading Aztec and Micro QR barcodes: removing a corner of a candidate shape read past the end of a buffer. (L#GDBC-500)
* Fixes Code 128 barcodes on low-resolution scans being read as a string of digits instead of their text. (L#GDBC-501)

#### Imaging

* Adds GdPictureImaging Scanner methods to scan on macOS (ImageCaptureCore) and on Windows and Linux (TWAIN). (GH#3430)
* Improves DWG and DXF conversion with R13 and R14 DWG support, wipeouts, draw order, true-color layers and 3D meshes. (L#GDPIC-1564)
* Upgrades bundled image codecs and network libraries to versions that fix published security vulnerabilities. (GH#3938)
* Changes TwainSetDebugMode and TwainSetErrorMessage to log messages instead of showing message boxes. (GH#3430)
* Fixes a crash when reading or writing the pixels of an image area larger than 2 GB. (GH#3817)
* Fixes ConvertTo8BppQ, ConvertTo4BppQ and GIF saving dropping content from the lower part of an image, which left PDF pages rendered at 24 bits per pixel blank. (L#GDPIC-1653)
* Fixes DWG and DXF conversions drawing content from layers that AutoCAD does not plot. (L#GDPIC-1564)
* Fixes DWG files that converted to a blank page or to only part of the drawing. (L#GDPIC-1411, L#GDPIC-1564)
* Fixes GdPictureImaging.ClearImage filling 4-bit images with the wrong color. (GH#4000)
* Fixes misplaced arcs, circles, polylines and blocks drawn in tilted or mirrored planes in DWG and DXF conversions. (L#GDPIC-1564)

#### OCR

* Fixes image-processing warnings written to the standard error output during OCR. (L#OCR-1115)
* Fixes wrong page orientation detection for pages with a small text area, such as an ID card scanned on a blank sheet. (L#OCR-1090)

#### Office

* Adds optional error details for failed DocProcessor conversions. (L#GDPIC-1673)
* Adds support for loading and converting Word 2003 XML (WordprocessingML 2003) documents. (L#MAMBO-2142)
* Improves diagnostics for confirmed invalid Word packages in DocProcessor. (L#GDPIC-1680)
* Improves the speed and file size of Office to PDF conversion for documents with gradient fills. (L#MAMBO-2160)
* Fixes a gray line along the edges of transparent EMF and WMF pictures in Office documents converted to PDF. (L#MAMBO-2086)
* Fixes a thin gray edge around transparent PNG pictures when converting Word documents and other files to PDF. (L#MAMBO-2128)
* Fixes Arabic letters dropped from Word documents converted to PDF when the font draws their joined forms through OpenType substitutions, as Simplified Arabic, Dubai and Arabic Typesetting do. (L#MAMBO-2154)
* Fixes chart titles missing from Excel, PowerPoint and Word documents converted to PDF when the file leaves out the autoTitleDeleted setting, as files written by XlsxWriter, Google Sheets and older Excel versions do. (L#MAMBO-2140)
* Fixes Excel headers and footers converted at the edge of the page instead of at their header and footer margins, and pictures inserted in headers and footers missing from the converted PDF. Excel sheets set to be centered on the page are now centered. (L#MAMBO-2138)
* Fixes Excel sheets converted by DocProcessor ignoring the page margins set in the sheet. (L#MAMBO-2138)
* Fixes footnotes and endnotes referenced from right-to-left text being dropped when converting Word documents to PDF. (L#MAMBO-2086)
* Fixes garbled Hebrew and other non-Latin subjects in older MSG emails that declare their code page. (L#DV-798)
* Fixes justified right-to-left Word documents breaking a line between a word and the punctuation written against it, so a comma or closing parenthesis no longer starts a line. (L#MAMBO-2163)
* Fixes lines and arrows drawn on Excel sheets, and cells with a single diagonal border, missing from the converted PDF. Excel sheets set to print in black and white are now converted the way Excel prints them. (L#MAMBO-2120)
* Fixes list numbers and right-to-left paragraph indents of Word 97-2003 (.doc) documents converted to PDF: Arabic, Hebrew and other list number styles, lists with no number, and indents saved by Word 97. (L#MAMBO-2086)
* Fixes list numbers in right-to-left paragraphs of Word documents converted to PDF being drawn with the Latin font instead of the complex-script one. (L#MAMBO-2159)
* Fixes MSG email bodies being cut off after the first line when preformatted text was displayed. (L#GDPIC-1395)
* Fixes Office documents converted to PDF so legacy VML shapes, picture colour modes, transparent picture colours and grouped shapes look as they do in Word and PowerPoint. (L#MAMBO-2139)
* Fixes Office documents failing to open in .NET Framework web applications that impersonate users. (L#DV-776)
* Fixes PowerPoint presentations failing to convert with InvalidParameter when a theme has no name, and slides being drawn with another slide master's theme when two themes share a name. (L#MAMBO-2150)
* Fixes right-to-left tables in Word documents being drawn on the wrong side of the page: their alignment and indentation now start from the right edge, as in Word. (L#MAMBO-2164)
* Fixes subtitle text in PowerPoint presentations shifted right, or placed at the wrong height, when the slide master sets the text box margins or vertical alignment. (L#MAMBO-2135)
* Fixes the height of empty paragraphs whose paragraph mark is right-to-left in Word documents converted to PDF: they now use the complex-script font and size, as Word does. (L#MAMBO-2086)
* Fixes Word 2003 XML documents being detected as Flat OPC Word documents and failing to load with GenericError; they now report UnsupportedFormat, and rejected Flat OPC loads no longer leave temporary files behind. (L#MAMBO-2141)
* Fixes Word 97-2003 (.doc) documents converted to PDF drawing table rows in the wrong columns, so right-to-left tables no longer collapse and rows Word shows as a separate table no longer shift the table around them. (L#MAMBO-2086)
* Fixes Word documents converted to PDF repeating the content of a nested table, or pushing a table onto a later page, when the table holds floating pictures or nested floating tables; nested tables in vertical-text cells now stay upright. (L#MAMBO-2149)
* Fixes Word documents created with WPS Office failing to open with InvalidParameter when a VML shape has an empty type. (L#MAMBO-2173)

#### PDF

* Adds a FIPS mode that runs all document cryptography in the operating system's FIPS 140-3 validated module and refuses non-approved algorithms. (L#NAT-681)
* Adds GdPictureDocumentUtilities.SetCryptoBackend to run PDF signing and encryption on Botan, BouncyCastle or the OS. (GH#3677)
* Adds GdPictureDocumentUtilities.SetFipsMode: FIPS mode, detected or forced, runs PDF cryptography on the OS library and refuses RC4, MD5 and SHA-1. (L#NAT-666)
* Adds PDF signature validation against trusted certificates, with revocation and timestamp checks (ETSI EN 319 102-1). (L#GDPIC-1671)
* Adds GdPictureDocumentUtilities.SetFipsMode and GetFipsMode to force or read FIPS mode, in .NET and in the COM edition. (L#NAT-681)
* Adds HTML conversion controls and private-network allow lists while preserving linked local resources. (GH#4055)
* Adds in-place PDF tag moves, grouping, unwrapping, merging and removal through structure import. (GH#3862)
* Improves PDF/UA auto-tagging: captions are tagged as Caption, and footnotes as Note, referenced from their calls. (L#DWS-1221)
* Changes PDF encryption to run in the library SetCryptoBackend selects: BouncyCastle by default, not the OS library. (GH#3677)
* Changes PDF redaction to write black-and-white images losslessly, so content outside a redaction area keeps its shape. (GH#4000)
* Changes the page marker in PDF to Markdown output from nutrient-page-start to document-page. (L#XT-840)
* Fixes GdPicturePDF.SaveToFile with encryption saving the document unencrypted when the encryption scheme is refused. (L#NAT-666)
* Fixes PKCS#12 files that demand excessive key-derivation work tying up a signing thread; they are now refused. (GH#3677)
* Fixes valid digital signatures reported as invalid when their signature data ends with a zero byte. (GH#3677)
* Fixes a crash when adding a 1-bit, 4-bit or 8-bit image larger than 4 GB to a PDF. (GH#3817)
* Fixes GetSignatureInfo returning CertificateWrongFormat for adbe.x509.rsa_sha1 signatures. (L#NAT-666)
* Fixes invalid-content reporting for PDFs whose readable catalog lacks a usable page-tree dictionary. (L#DWS-1272)
* Fixes malformed PDF trailers being reported as access-denied errors. (GH#3901)
* Fixes new signature fields always named Signature1: they take the signer name, with periods as _ and _2 added if taken. (L#GDPDF-1545)
* Fixes PDF redaction leaving pixels of inline, undecodable, 4-bit and rotated images under a redaction area. (GH#4000)
* Fixes PDF redaction removing text that a page draws after a form XObject. (GH#4000)
* Fixes PDF tag reading order. Ordered tag imports now require patch mode without conformance conversion. (GH#3999)
* Fixes PDF text extraction joining words when a font leaves its blank space glyph out of the Unicode map. (L#XT-827)
* Fixes PDF text extraction placing form field values at the wrong position when the page content leaves a scale in effect. (L#XT-634)
* Fixes PDF/UA auto-tagging giving images the actual text "Image", which screen readers read instead of the alt text. (L#DWS-1215)
* Fixes PDF/UA auto-tagging joining headings to nearby text or lists, flattening heading levels and missing ordered lists. (L#DWS-1217, L#DWS-1218, L#DWS-1219)
* Fixes PDF/UA auto-tagging tagging running headers, footers and page numbers as paragraphs instead of artifacts. (L#DWS-1216)
* Fixes PDF/UA auto-tagging titling a multi-page document after its last page's heading instead of its first. (L#DWS-1220)
* Fixes signature fields below a parent form field being left out when PDF signatures are counted, read or validated. (L#GDPIC-1671)
* Fixes the media-load timeout being ignored when converting EML and MSG emails to PDF. (L#DV-536)
* Fixes unsafe HTML markup in HTML and Markdown exports by escaping document text by default. (L#GDPIC-1676)
* Fixes verification of RSA-PSS signatures with a non-default salt length and of DSA signatures over SHA-2. (GH#3677)

#### Templating

* API: Adds AddSubTemplateFromFile and AddSubTemplateFromBytes to GdPictureOfficeTemplateBuilder. (L#OFTAPI-30)
* Adds DOCX sub-templates to Word templates: a placeholder can insert another Word document, filled from the same data. (L#OFTAPI-30)
* Adds formatted HTML placeholder values to PowerPoint and Excel templates, with lists and links. (L#OFTAPI-29)
* Fixes Word template processing failing when an HTML value in a header or footer adds the document's first list. (L#OFTAPI-30)

#### Viewers

* Fixes a crash in the COM edition viewer when the host application unmasks floating-point exceptions, such as Xbase++. (L#GDPIC-942)
* Fixes a crash in the WPF GdViewer when a text annotation's edit box is closed right after it opens. (L#GDPIC-1665)
